name: Reward Gateway Corporate Wellbeing
summary: Reward Gateway's corporate wellbeing app runs activity and wellness challenges, gives access to a library of wellbeing content, and offers downloadable reports on individual performance and engagement. The page shows no price and directs visitors to a demo.

facts.text: Reward Gateway Corporate Wellbeing's page says the app can run challenges based on any activity, including virtual fitness and walking challenges and habit streaks.
On the vendor's page, the app gives access to a library of wellbeing content, including workouts, meditations and recipes, and a Wellbeing+ Playbook is described.
Reward Gateway's page says buyers can download reports with detailed data on individual performance and engagement, and that user analytics identify the most improved participants.
The page does not describe health coaching or health screenings. It shows no price and offers a demo.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: The vendor publishes no price on this page. Pricing is available on request only.

hiddenCosts: The vendor publishes no price on this page, so no amount is recorded. The participation evidence describes individual-level reports, so check whether team-level reports are included.
